description: Profile page, User preferences, Keyboard shortcuts, and final polish. Implements the user profile page with settings, the Help Center panel, keyboard shortcuts (Ctrl+K search, navigation shortcuts), system banner display, and overall UX refinements to ensure the app meets the design.md quality bar.
steps: Create src/app/(protected)/profile/page.tsx: User Profile page. Sections: Personal Info (name, email, designation, department, section, employee_id, phone - read-only for non-admin), Preferences (theme preference, notification settings, default view options), Session Info (last login, current session started, role display), Password Change form (current + new + confirm). Uses design system cards and forms

Create src/components/shared/help-center.tsx: Help Center Sheet/Dialog. Triggered from header button or sidebar utility. Sections: Search docs (input), Keyboard Shortcuts (table of shortcuts), Page Guide (context-specific help text), Release Notes (mock version history), Contact Support (mock form). Dense panel per design.md

Create src/components/shared/keyboard-shortcuts.tsx: Global keyboard shortcut handler using useEffect. Shortcuts: Ctrl+K (command palette), Ctrl+/ (keyboard shortcuts help), g then d (go to dashboard), g then p (go to PL hub), g then o (go to documents), g then l (go to ledger), g then b (go to BOM), Escape (close modals/panels). Display shortcuts in Help Center table

Create src/components/layout/system-banner.tsx: System-wide banner component displayed below header when active banners exist. Types: info (blue), warning (amber), critical (red). Dismissible per user session. Shows message text and optional action link
Create src/components/shared/user-menu.tsx: User dropdown menu in header. Shows: user name, role badge, quick links (Profile, Preferences, Keyboard Shortcuts), Sign Out. Uses DropdownMenu from shadcn

Update src/components/layout/app-header.tsx: Replace placeholder user area with proper UserMenu component. Ensure all header elements are properly connected: notification panel, clock, help center, theme toggle, user menu
Create src/components/shared/page-loading.tsx: Full page loading state with skeleton matching the page layout (header skeleton + content area skeleton). Used during page transitions

Final design audit - update all pages to ensure: (1) Page frames are top-centered with proper margins, (2) All tables use shadow-table + border, (3) All cards use shadow-card + border + hover animation, (4) Button heights are 30px, (5) Input heights are 30-34px, (6) Font sizes follow the design system scale, (7) Independent scroll regions work correctly, (8) Dark mode renders correctly on all pages
Create src/app/not-found.tsx: Custom 404 page following design system. Compact message with navigation back
Create src/app/error.tsx: Custom error boundary page following design system. Shows error message, retry button, back to dashboard link
Update graphify.json: Mark all tasks as completed, record final state
Verify: 'npm run build' succeeds, 'npm run lint' passes, all pages render correctly in both themes
acceptance_criteria: Profile page shows user info and preferences
Help Center opens with search, keyboard shortcuts table, page guide
Ctrl+K opens command palette from any page
Keyboard navigation shortcuts work (g+d for dashboard, etc.)
System banners display below header when active
User menu shows name, role, sign out option
404 and error pages follow design system
All pages pass the design.md quality bar checklist (Section 18)
Dark mode works correctly on all pages
verification: Run 'npm run build' and confirm exit 0
Run 'npm run lint' and confirm no errors
Verify graphify.json shows all tasks completed
findings: All components created successfully. Select onValueChange type expects string|null (base-ui pattern). Biome autoformatted 7 files on first check. Pre-existing lint format errors in db/schema files remain unchanged. Build passes with all routes including /profile. graphify.json marks all 15 features completed.
